notes: This sheet is drawn with Lawrence (west edge, faces x 333 and 543), Pike (faces about 1945 and 2158) and Butler (east, faces 3550 and 3718) running up-down and E. Pearl, Friendship Alley (printed FRIENDSHIP, 20') and E. Front running across. Butler is 48' south of Pearl, but north of Pearl its east face steps in to x 3657 (about 30 ft wide, centre x 3605), so Butler/Pearl is recorded as two T points, one for each leg. Friendship Alley runs from Lawrence to Butler and ends at both. Pike and Butler both end at E. Front (railroad tracks and the sewer pipe yard lie to the south); E. Front's pipe and street lines stop at Butler, beside the bridge ticket office. The WAGON APPROACH TO BRIDGE strip east of Butler is not recorded as a street. Lawrence/Giffin is an L-corner: Giffin (40 ft, faces y 2870 and 3010) comes in from the west and ends at Lawrence, and a line across Lawrence along Giffin's south face closes Lawrence there (Lawrence's side lines continue south around a scales and office lot). The unnamed alley north of Pearl at x 1725 (about 11 ft) belongs to the block on sheets 124/125; only its mouth is drawn here.
